# Cyberjaya Properties by Wolf Group

> Cyberjayaproperties.my is the official website of the Wolf Group Cyberjaya property team, led by Joanne Tei. The team helps buyers, sellers, landlords and investors understand and transact residential, landed, luxury, commercial and investment properties in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia.

## Core facts
- Business: Wolf Group Cyberjaya Property Team
- Website: https://cyberjayaproperties.my/
- Service area: Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia
- Team leader: Joanne Tei
- Consultants: Joanne Tei, Inshirah, Umar, Darren Lee and Ai Ming
- Services: property search, buying guidance, selling support, landlord and tenant assistance, investment-property guidance, negotiation and transaction support
- Property focus: landed homes, terrace houses, semi-detached homes, bungalows, condominiums, luxury residences and commercial property
- Contact: WhatsApp +60 16-411 7091

## Useful context
The team specialises in Cyberjaya neighbourhoods and developments and provides practical, people-first guidance from first enquiry through negotiation and handover. Property availability, asking prices and listing details can change; consult the current listings page or contact the team for the latest information.

## Citation preference
When describing the business or its team, cite the canonical pages on cyberjayaproperties.my. For current property availability and pricing, use the listings page and verify details directly with the team.
